examTitle: AB-900: Microsoft 365 Copilot and Agent Administration Fundamentals

questions.questionText: Select the answer that correctly completes the sentence. You can use [___] to review threat indicators correlated across email, identity, and device incidents in a single view.
options: A. Microsoft Defender XDR in the Microsoft Defender portal
E. Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention
questions.explanation: Microsoft Defender XDR correlates security alerts and events from across the organization into unified incidents, providing investigation context spanning email, identities, and endpoints/devices.

learnMore.text: Microsoft Defender XDR in the Microsoft Defender portal

questions.questionText: Your organization has a Microsoft 365 subscription. You create a security group named Group1 and assign the group a Microsoft 365 E3 license. You discover that a user named User1 does not have access to the Microsoft 365 E3 features. You need to ensure that User1 can access every Microsoft 365 E3 feature. Which two actions can you take? Each correct answer provides a complete solution. NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point. Choose two
options: B. Assign a Conditional Access policy to Group1.
C. Assign a Conditional Access policy to User1.
D. Assign a license to User1.
questions.explanation: Group-based licensing assigns the group’s product licenses to its members, so adding User1 to Group1 provides the Microsoft 365 E3 license. A Microsoft 365 E3 license can alternatively be assigned directly to User1. Conditional Access policies govern the conditions under which access is allowed and do not grant product-license entitlements.

learnMore.text: Assign or unassign licenses to a group in the Microsoft 365 admin center
Assign or unassign licenses for users in the Microsoft 365 admin center

questions.questionText: Your organization has a Microsoft 365 subscription that includes a user named User1. User1 intends to leave the company in two weeks. You need to capture User1’s activity to determine whether the user is exfiltrating data. Which Microsoft Purview solution should you use?
questions.explanation: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management detects, investigates, and helps mitigate risky insider activity. Its Data theft by departing users policy template detects suspicious activity associated with potential data theft or exfiltration by users who are leaving the organization. Microsoft Learn: Insider Risk Management

learnMore.text: Microsoft Learn: Insider Risk Management

questions.questionText: Select the answer that correctly completes the sentence. Conditional Access policies [___]
options: A. Microsoft Entra Conditional Access overview
B. are configured by using the Microsoft Defender portal.
C. are applied only to on-premises resources.
D. provide control over how users can access cloud apps.
E. require a Microsoft Exchange mailbox.
questions.explanation: Microsoft Entra Conditional Access evaluates access signals and enforces access controls for cloud applications. Policies are configured in the Microsoft Entra admin center and do not depend on an Exchange mailbox.

learnMore.text: Microsoft Entra Conditional Access overview

questions.questionText: For each statement, select Yes

statements.text: Microsoft 365 Copilot honors Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels.
Microsoft 365 Copilot ignores Microsoft Purview data loss prevention (DLP) policies.
Microsoft 365 Copilot honors existing Microsoft 365 permissions.

questions.explanation: Microsoft 365 Copilot recognizes and uses Purview sensitivity labels, and it honors the user’s existing access permissions when grounding responses. Purview DLP policies can restrict sensitive content in Copilot grounding and interactions, so Copilot does not ignore them.

learnMore.text: Learn about sensitivity labels
Microsoft 365 Copilot data protection architecture

questions.questionText: You need to build a Microsoft 365 Copilot agent that can generate charts and visualizations from a Microsoft Excel workbook. What should you configure for the agent?
options: C. the Customer Insights Assistant template
questions.explanation: The code interpreter capability enables a Microsoft 365 Copilot agent to analyze Excel data and create graphs, charts, and other data visualizations using generated Python code in a sandboxed environment.

learnMore.text: Code Interpreter Capability for Declarative Agents for Microsoft 365 Copilot

questions.questionText: For each statement below, select Yes

statements.text: Microsoft Purview DSPM for AI can provide insight into ChatGPT usage.
Microsoft Purview DSPM for AI can provide insight into Microsoft 365 Copilot usage.
Microsoft Purview DSPM for AI can block users from using Microsoft 365 Copilot.

questions.explanation: Microsoft Purview DSPM for AI delivers insights and analytics for AI activity, including supported third-party AI sites such as ChatGPT and Microsoft 365 Copilot. DSPM for AI provides visibility, recommendations, and integration with Purview controls; it does not control whether users can access Microsoft 365 Copilot.

learnMore.text: Learn about Microsoft Purview Data Security Posture Management for AI
Use Microsoft Purview to manage data security and compliance for Microsoft 365 Copilot

questions.questionText: Your company uses Microsoft Purview data loss prevention (DLP) policies. A user named User1 shares sensitive information to an external user by using Microsoft Teams. You need to identify the sensitive content that was shared. What should you use in the Microsoft Purview portal?
questions.explanation: Activity explorer collects DLP policy match events from workloads including Teams chat and channels, so an administrator can drill into the specific external-sharing incident to see who shared what, when, where, and which sensitive information type triggered the match. Content explorer instead shows a current snapshot of items already carrying a label or sensitive information type across data stores, rather than a record of a specific past sharing event.

learnMore.text: Get started with Activity explorer

questions.questionText: Select the answer that correctly completes the sentence. From the SharePoint admin center, you can create a [___]
options: A. Manage sites in the SharePoint admin center
questions.explanation: The SharePoint admin center is used to create and manage SharePoint sites. It is not used to create servers, users, or Microsoft 365 roles.

learnMore.text: Manage sites in the SharePoint admin center

questions.questionText: Select the answer that correctly completes the sentence. User1 is [___] Site1.
questions.explanation: “Everyone except external users” automatically includes internal users in the organization. Because that principal is a member of Site1’s Site members group, User1 receives the members group’s Edit access.

learnMore.text: Default SharePoint groups

questions.questionText: Select the answer that correctly completes the sentence. Resolving the [___] recommendation will improve the Identity Secure Score the most.
options: B. Use least privileged administrative roles
C. Enable policy to block legacy authentication
D. Require multifactor authentication for administrative roles
questions.explanation: Microsoft Entra Secure Score recommendations contribute only their unachieved points. Requiring multifactor authentication for administrative roles has 0 of 10 points achieved, so resolving it adds up to 10 points. Blocking legacy authentication has only 7.27 points remaining, while the other two recommendations are already fully achieved.

questions.questionText: You are reviewing your company’s security policies as part of a Zero Trust strategy. Which statement accurately describes the Zero Trust principles?
options: A. Zero Trust enhances the user experience by minimizing authentication prompts.
B. Zero Trust assumes breach and verifies each request.
C. Zero Trust treats all requests from your corporate network as trustworthy.
D. Zero Trust removes the need to regularly review and adjust access permissions.
questions.explanation: Zero Trust rests on three principles: verify explicitly, use least-privileged access, and assume breach, so every request is authenticated and authorized rather than trusted by default. Treating traffic from the corporate network as inherently trustworthy or reducing authentication prompts and access reviews runs counter to this model.

questions.questionText: Your organization has a Microsoft 365 subscription. You need to use Microsoft Purview to satisfy these requirements: Discover and classify sensitive data across multiple platforms. Block users from sharing intellectual property with external users. Which Microsoft Purview solution should you use for each requirement?

statements.text: Discover and classify sensitive data across multiple platforms:
Block users from sharing intellectual property with external users:

questions.explanation: Microsoft Purview Information Protection discovers and classifies sensitive information across the organization. Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention uses policies to prevent prohibited sharing, including sharing sensitive items with external users.

questions.explanation: Sensitivity-label configuration is managed in the Microsoft Purview portal, under Information Protection > Sensitivity labels. The label list there lets administrators open a label and view its configured settings; SharePoint only displays the label assigned to the document.

statements.text: A Communication Compliance policy can detect inappropriate text in Microsoft Teams messages.
A Communication Compliance policy can detect offensive language in Microsoft 365 Copilot prompts.
A Communication Compliance policy can be used to retain email messages for 10 years.

questions.explanation: Communication Compliance detects inappropriate, abusive, and offensive text in Teams communications and can analyze Microsoft 365 Copilot prompts and responses for inappropriate or risky interactions. Retaining email for a fixed 10-year period requires Microsoft Purview retention policies or retention labels, rather than a Communication Compliance policy.

statements.text: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 provides protection from phishing and malware attacks.
Microsoft Defender for Identity monitors identities in Active Directory domains.
Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management provides protection for software as a service (SaaS) applications.

questions.explanation: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 protects email and collaboration workloads against phishing and malware. Microsoft Defender for Identity provides monitoring and detection for identities in Active Directory environments. Defender Vulnerability Management focuses on discovering, assessing, prioritizing, and remediating vulnerabilities across organizational assets; SaaS application protection is a Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps capability.

learnMore.text: Why do I need Microsoft Defender for Office 365?
Microsoft Defender for Identity overview

questions.questionText: Your organization has a Microsoft 365 subscription. You discover that some users cannot sign in to Microsoft 365. You need to view the failed Microsoft 365 sign-in attempts. What should you use?
options: B. the Microsoft Entra admin center
questions.explanation: Failed sign-in attempts are logged in Microsoft Entra (formerly Azure AD) admin center, accessible via the Identity > Monitoring & health > Sign-in logs path or via individual user sign-in logs. These logs show authentication failures, multi-factor authentication failures, and other sign-in issues. Other admin centers (Microsoft 365, Defender, Purview) do not provide detailed sign-in diagnostics.

questions.questionText: A user named User1 is responsible for quarterly sales reporting. User1 needs to identify performance trends, generate visual insights, and create a summary of anomalies across multiple files that contain various datasets. What should you use?
options: A. the Analyst agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot
B. the Researcher agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot
questions.explanation: The Analyst agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot is specifically designed to work across multiple data files simultaneously, performing advanced data analysis including trend identification, generating charts and visual insights automatically, surfacing anomalies and patterns, and producing written summaries of findings. This directly matches the stated requirements for identifying performance trends, generating visual insights, and summarizing anomalies across multiple datasets.

questions.questionText: Select the answer that correctly completes the sentence. Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels can be applied to [___]
options: A. Use sensitivity labels to protect collaborative workspaces (groups and sites)
questions.explanation: Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels support SharePoint sites as protected containers, where the label can govern settings such as access and external sharing.

learnMore.text: Use sensitivity labels to protect collaborative workspaces (groups and sites)

questions.questionText: For each statement below, select Yes

statements.text: A sensitivity label can be applied to a Microsoft SharePoint site.
A sensitivity label can be applied to an email message in Microsoft Exchange.
A sensitivity label can be applied to Windows 11 devices.

questions.explanation: Sensitivity labels can protect SharePoint sites through the Groups & sites scope and can be applied to email messages through the Emails scope. They are not applied to Windows devices themselves; Windows integration enables labeling supported files, not the device.

learnMore.text: Learn about sensitivity labels
Use sensitivity labels to protect collaborative workspaces (groups and sites)

questions.questionText: You use Microsoft 365 Copilot. You need to schedule a prompt to run at midnight. What task should you include in your solution?
questions.explanation: Scheduling a prompt in Microsoft 365 Copilot requires first submitting the prompt and receiving a response; only then does the "Schedule this prompt" option appear, letting you set its recurrence, including a midnight run time. Saving a prompt, creating an agent, or building a notebook does not by itself surface the scheduling option.

learnMore.text: Schedule your most used Copilot prompts

questions.questionText: For each statement, select Yes

statements.text: For administrators to use SharePoint Advanced Management, all the users in your organization need a Microsoft 365 Copilot license.
SharePoint Advanced Management can help restrict Microsoft 365 Copilot from accessing Microsoft SharePoint content.
SharePoint Advanced Management is available as a standalone license for organizations without Microsoft 365 Copilot.

questions.explanation: Only one assigned Microsoft 365 Copilot license is required for SharePoint administrators to receive the applicable SAM capabilities; licenses are not required for every user. SAM can use Restricted Content Discovery or Restricted Access Control to keep site content from surfacing in Copilot or limit access to an allowed group. Organizations without Copilot can obtain SAM through a standalone license.

Restrict discovery of SharePoint sites and content

statements.text: You can use a Microsoft Entra security group to assign permissions to Microsoft Entra ID resources.
You can use a Microsoft Entra security group to assign Microsoft 365 licenses.
You can use a Microsoft Entra security group to assign permissions to Microsoft Exchange mailboxes.

questions.explanation: Microsoft Entra security groups can be assigned access to directory resources, applications, and services. Security groups also support group-based Microsoft 365 license assignment. Exchange mailbox permissions require an Exchange-recognized, mail-enabled security group or another supported Exchange recipient; a standard Microsoft Entra security group alone does not meet that requirement.

questions.explanation: Number matching requires the user to enter the number displayed during sign-in into the Microsoft Authenticator approval prompt. It is an Authenticator push-notification MFA method.

statements.text: Zero Trust requires an Azure subscription.
Zero Trust is a security strategy, NOT a specific product.
From the Microsoft 365 admin center, you can enable Zero Trust for your organization.

questions.explanation: Zero Trust is a security strategy that can be implemented across cloud and on-premises environments; it is not contingent on an Azure subscription. Microsoft explicitly states that Zero Trust is a strategy rather than a product or service. The Microsoft 365 admin center provides the advanced deployment guide to set up the Microsoft Zero Trust security model for an organization.

questions.questionText: Select the answer that correctly completes the sentence. In Microsoft 365 Copilot, you should use [___] to perform multi-step reasoning over unstructured data.
options: A. Get started with Researcher in Microsoft 365 Copilot
B. Get started with Analyst in Microsoft 365 Copilot
questions.explanation: The Researcher agent is designed for complex, multi-step research and deep reasoning across work content and web sources. The Analyst agent is intended for structured data analysis, such as spreadsheets, CSV files, and databases.

learnMore.text: Get started with Researcher in Microsoft 365 Copilot
Get started with Analyst in Microsoft 365 Copilot

questions.questionText: Select the answer that correctly completes the sentence. You can use the [___] Microsoft Purview solution to find all the content that relates to the term “Project Falcon” in the emails exchanged by two users.
questions.explanation: Microsoft Purview eDiscovery supports searching Microsoft 365 email and other content locations for relevant content using keywords and conditions.

learnMore.text: Microsoft Purview eDiscovery search

questions.questionText: Your organization has a Microsoft 365 subscription. You need to generate a report that shows the permissions and active sharing links of content stored in Microsoft OneDrive accounts. What should you use?
options: A. Audit in the Microsoft Defender portal
B. Reports in the Microsoft 365 admin center
C. Data access governance in the SharePoint admin center
D. eDiscovery in the Microsoft Purview portal
questions.explanation: Data access governance in the SharePoint admin center provides comprehensive visibility into file permissions and active sharing links across OneDrive and SharePoint. It reports on external sharing, permission assignments, and overshared content, enabling compliance audits. Audit logs, general reports, and eDiscovery serve different purposes but lack the integrated permissions and sharing-link visibility.

questions.questionText: Your organization has a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription. You need to ensure that a third-party cloud service can authenticate with Microsoft Entra. What should you configure?
questions.explanation: An app registration establishes the service's application identity and trust relationship with Microsoft Entra, enabling it to authenticate by using configured application credentials and permissions.

learnMore.text: Register an application with the Microsoft identity platform
Application and service principal objects in Microsoft Entra ID

questions.questionText: Your company has a written compliance policy that requires all emails be retained for seven years, and then permanently deleted. Which Microsoft Purview solution should you use?
questions.explanation: Data Lifecycle Management in Microsoft Purview automates retention policies and deletion schedules. Administrators define retention periods (7 years in this case) and specify deletion actions that execute automatically when the retention period expires. Information Protection handles sensitivity; Data Loss Prevention prevents unauthorized sharing; Insider Risk Management detects risky user behaviors—none address automated retention and deletion.

questions.questionText: Your company plans to use Microsoft 365 Copilot. You need to provide a user with the ability to use Microsoft 365 Copilot, including the Researcher and Analyst agent. What should you use?
options: C. the Microsoft Entra admin center
questions.explanation: Access to Microsoft 365 Copilot and its built-in agents, including Researcher and Analyst, is granted and managed from the Microsoft 365 admin center under Copilot settings, where administrators assign licenses and control which users can use specific agents. Purview, Entra, and Defender govern data protection, identity, and security workloads rather than Copilot licensing and agent access.

questions.questionText: Select the answer that correctly completes the sentence. From the Microsoft Teams admin center, you can [___]
options: A. Manage devices in Microsoft Teams
C. assign a Teams license to a user.
E. manage a Teams Rooms device.
questions.explanation: The Microsoft Teams admin center supports device management for Teams Rooms, such as viewing device status and applying settings. License assignment is handled in Microsoft 365 administration, while restrictions on creating teams are configured through Microsoft 365 group creation settings.

learnMore.text: Manage devices in Microsoft Teams
Managing Microsoft Teams Rooms

questions.questionText: For each statement, select Yes when it is true. Otherwise, select No.

statements.text: Administrators can remove a specific Copilot agent from all users.
From the Microsoft 365 admin center, administrators can configure the prompts of a Copilot agent.
Administrators can deploy Copilot agents to specific users.

questions.explanation: Administrators can remove or block an individual agent organization-wide and can deploy agents to selected users or groups. The Microsoft 365 admin center governs agent access, visibility, and lifecycle; configuring an agent’s prompts is performed in the agent-authoring experience, such as Microsoft Copilot Studio.

learnMore.text: Agent Registry in the Microsoft 365 admin center
Configure suggested prompts for Teams and Microsoft 365

questions.questionText: Your company is evaluating Microsoft 365 Copilot licensing. In which scenario should you use pay-as-you-go billing?
options: A. to provide users with access to the AI assistant in Copilot in Word
B. to summarize the actions in Microsoft Teams meetings
C. to generate images in premium chats
D. to make a custom agent available to unlicensed users
questions.explanation: Pay-as-you-go billing for Microsoft 365 Copilot allows organizations to extend Copilot capabilities to unlicensed users without purchasing full per-user licenses. This model is specifically used when making custom agents available to users who do not have a Copilot license, billing based on consumption rather than per-user licensing. The other options (Researcher agent, Teams meeting recaps, and Word editing) are included in standard Copilot licensing.

questions.questionText: For each statement, select Yes

statements.text: From the Copilot Prompt Gallery, you can modify a saved prompt.
From the Copilot Prompt Gallery, you can share a saved prompt to a Microsoft Teams team.
You can create a shared link for a prompt that was NOT saved to the Copilot Prompt Gallery.

questions.explanation: Microsoft's own support documentation for Prompt Gallery states that from Your Prompts you can click any saved prompt to view, edit, or run it, so a saved prompt can indeed be modified in place. Prompt Gallery also lets a user share a saved prompt directly with a Microsoft Teams team. However, the sharing workflow is only exposed for prompts that already exist in Your Prompts (accessed by hovering a saved prompt and selecting the share option), so a prompt that was never saved cannot be turned into a shared link.

learnMore.text: Save your favorite prompts to use again
Understand Prompt Gallery in Copilot

images.alt: Answer: Change history highlighted in SharePoint admin center

questions.questionText: Your organization has a Microsoft 365 subscription that contains a Microsoft SharePoint site named Site1. You need to prevent users from sharing the content of Site1 to external users. What should you use?
options: D. the Microsoft Entra admin center
questions.explanation: External sharing permissions are controlled in the SharePoint admin center's Active sites section. Administrators select the target site and configure External sharing settings, restricting sharing to organization members only. These controls exist at the admin level, not at individual content or via other admin centers.

questions.questionText: Which statement accurately describes authorization in Microsoft 365?
options: A. a process to verify whether an identity is who or what they claim to be
B. a process to require additional authentication methods before an identity can access resources
C. a process to verify whether an identity is allowed to access a resource
D. a process to validate an identity from an external system
questions.explanation: Authorization determines what an authenticated user is allowed to access and do within a system. After identity is verified (authentication), authorization policies grant or deny access to specific resources. Option A describes authentication; option B describes multi-factor authentication; option D describes identity federation or external identity validation.

questions.questionText: Select the answer that correctly completes the sentence. When you need to add a domain to a Microsoft 365 subscription, you must verify the domain by [___]
options: A. Gather the information you need to create DNS records - Microsoft 365 admin
B. adding a public DNS record.
questions.explanation: Microsoft 365 verifies that an organization controls a custom domain by checking a DNS record that it adds at the domain’s DNS host, typically a TXT record.

learnMore.text: Gather the information you need to create DNS records - Microsoft 365 admin

questions.questionText: Your organization has a Microsoft 365 subscription. All users are assigned a Microsoft 365 Copilot license. You need to prevent the users from generating images by using Copilot. What should you use?
options: B. the Microsoft Entra admin center
questions.explanation: Image generation is a product feature within Microsoft 365 Copilot, not a security or compliance control. Therefore, it must be managed through the Microsoft 365 admin center where administrators can enable or disable product-specific features for the organization. The Defender portal manages security threats, Entra admin center manages identity and access, and Purview handles compliance—none of which are appropriate for controlling a productivity feature like image generation.

questions.questionText: You intend to create an agent in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app to address a business issue. What are two reasons to create the agent? Each correct answer provides a complete solution. NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point. Choose two
options: A. You need to use a custom AI model.
B. You need to use a custom set of instructions that differ from those of the chat experience.
C. You need to reason over a specific website.
D. You need to group related chats into a Copilot notebook.
questions.explanation: Microsoft 365 Copilot agents can be tailored to a business scenario by defining custom behavioral instructions and adding relevant knowledge sources. Website URLs can be configured as knowledge sources, allowing an agent to ground its responses in a specific website. Agent Builder does not provide a reason to create an agent merely to use a custom AI model or to organize related chats into a Copilot notebook.

learnMore.text: Write effective instructions for declarative agents
Add knowledge sources to your declarative agent

statements.text: You can use Search & intelligence in the Microsoft 365 admin center.
You can use Audit in the Microsoft Defender portal.
You can use Audit in the Microsoft Purview portal.

questions.explanation: Microsoft Purview Audit searches the Microsoft 365 unified audit log, which records administrator and user activities and identifies the account that performed each operation. Microsoft 365 admin center Search & intelligence is not the audit-log viewer, and Audit is accessed through the Microsoft Purview portal rather than the Microsoft Defender portal.

learnMore.text: Search the audit log
Audit log activities

questions.questionText: Select the answer that correctly completes the sentence. From the Microsoft Purview portal, you can use Data explorer to [___]
options: A. Get started with data explorer
B. create and manage privacy policies.
C. perform searches for content in mailboxes and sites.
D. identify sensitive information and where it is located.
E. review the effectiveness of your data loss prevention (DLP) policies.
questions.explanation: Microsoft Purview Data Explorer shows items classified by sensitive information types and enables investigation of the locations where those items reside.

learnMore.text: Get started with data explorer

questions.questionText: For each statement, select Yes

statements.text: Microsoft Purview Compliance Manager provides a risk-based compliance score to help you understand your compliance posture.
Microsoft Purview Compliance Manager provides step-by-step guidance to remediate compliance issues.
Compliance Manager is part of Microsoft Defender.

questions.explanation: Compliance Manager provides a risk-based compliance score that measures progress on improvement actions and helps assess compliance posture. It also provides detailed step-by-step guidance for suggested improvement actions. Compliance Manager is a Microsoft Purview feature rather than a component of Microsoft Defender.

learnMore.text: Microsoft Purview service description
Compliance Manager scoring

questions.questionText: Select the answer that correctly completes the sentence. [___] is a unified enterprise suite that coordinates detection, prevention, investigation, and response across endpoints, identities, email, and applications to provide integrated protection against sophisticated attacks.
options: A. What is Microsoft Defender XDR?
questions.explanation: Microsoft Defender XDR natively coordinates prevention, detection, investigation, and response across endpoints, identities, email, and applications, providing integrated protection against sophisticated attacks.

learnMore.text: What is Microsoft Defender XDR?

questions.questionText: Your company requires every Microsoft SharePoint site to have at least two owners. You need to make sites with fewer than two owners read-only when they are not remediated. What should you configure in the SharePoint admin center?
options: D. Block download policy for SharePoint and OneDrive
questions.explanation: SharePoint Site lifecycle management contains site ownership policies, which define the minimum required number of owners or administrators, notify responsible users about noncompliance, and support enforcement actions such as read-only access. Microsoft documents that setting the minimum owner count to two identifies sites requiring remediation.

learnMore.text: Create a SharePoint site ownership policy

questions.questionText: Your organization has a Microsoft 365 subscription. Which two tasks can you perform by using the Exchange admin center? Each correct answer presents part of the solution. NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point. Choose two
options: A. Assign a Microsoft Exchange license.
B. Create a mail flow rule.
questions.explanation: The Exchange admin center is where mail flow (transport) rules are created and managed, and it is also one of the places administrators create and configure shared mailboxes. Assigning licenses and adding a custom domain are tenant-wide setup tasks handled in the Microsoft 365 admin center, not the Exchange admin center.

questions.questionText: For each statement, select Yes when it is true. Otherwise, select No.

statements.text: Microsoft Purview Communications Compliance can detect offensive text in images stored in Microsoft SharePoint sites.
Microsoft Purview Communications Compliance anonymizes user identities by default during investigations.
Microsoft Purview Communications Compliance adds a disclaimer to all monitored communications.

questions.explanation: Communication Compliance evaluates supported communication channels rather than scanning SharePoint-stored images for offensive OCR text. Usernames are pseudonymized by default to protect privacy during review and investigation, with access controlled by roles. The service can investigate and remediate policy matches, but it does not add disclaimers to all monitored communications.

learnMore.text: Learn about Communication Compliance
Plan for Communication Compliance

questions.questionText: For each statement, select Yes when it is true. Otherwise, select No.

statements.text: To use Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat to reason over web data, you need a Microsoft 365 Copilot license.
To use the Researcher agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot, you need a Microsoft 365 Copilot license.
To add an agent in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app, you need a Microsoft 365 Copilot license.

questions.explanation: Web-grounded Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat is included with eligible Microsoft 365 subscriptions and does not require the paid Copilot add-on. Researcher is an additional capability available with a Microsoft 365 Copilot license. Agents can also be available in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app to subscription users through metered or no-additional-cost agent options, so a Copilot add-on license is not universally required just to add an agent.

learnMore.text: License options for Microsoft 365 Copilot
Microsoft 365 Copilot app overview for IT admins

questions.questionText: Select the answer that correctly completes the sentence. In the Microsoft 365 admin center, the Credits used metric in the Copilot credits report shows the total credits used by users in your organization that [___] and are interacting with work grounded agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat.
options: C. are external to your organization
D. are assigned a Microsoft 365 Copilot license
E. are NOT assigned a Microsoft 365 Copilot license
questions.explanation: The Copilot credits report measures metered agent interactions in Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat by users in the organization who are not assigned a Microsoft 365 Copilot license.

learnMore.text: Microsoft 365 Copilot credits report

questions.questionText: For each statement, select Yes

statements.text: Users can use Microsoft 365 Copilot anonymously.
Administrators can allow the self-service purchase of Microsoft 365 Copilot licenses.
Microsoft 365 Copilot licenses can be assigned to Microsoft Entra ID guest users from other organizations.

questions.explanation: Microsoft 365 Copilot requires a signed-in work or school account and appropriate licensing, so anonymous use is not supported. Administrators can allow users to buy Microsoft 365 Copilot licenses through the self-service purchase setting. Copilot licenses cannot be assigned to cross-tenant users, including Microsoft Entra guest users.

learnMore.text: Manage Microsoft 365 Copilot scenarios
Set up Microsoft 365 Copilot and assign licenses

questions.questionText: For each statement, select Yes when it is true. Otherwise, select No.

statements.text: Users that are assigned a Microsoft 365 E5 license can create Microsoft 365 Copilot agents grounded in the web.
Users must be assigned a Microsoft 365 Copilot license to use the Analyst agent.
Users can use a natural language prompt to create a Microsoft 365 Copilot agent.

questions.explanation: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat is available to users with a qualifying Microsoft 365 subscription, including E5, and web-grounded declarative agents are available at no additional cost. Analyst is designated as a Microsoft 365 Copilot Premium feature, which requires the Microsoft 365 Copilot add-on license. Agent Builder supports creating agents by describing the intended agent in natural language.

learnMore.text: Using agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat
Microsoft 365 Copilot service description

questions.questionText: For each statement, select Yes

statements.text: The Microsoft 365 Copilot usage report can be used to view Copilot prompts submitted by users.
The Microsoft 365 Copilot usage report shows the total number of unique users in your organization that are assigned Microsoft 365 Copilot licenses.
The Microsoft 365 Copilot usage report shows the Copilot usage of each individual Microsoft 365 app.

questions.explanation: The report exposes prompt-submission metrics, not the actual prompt content. Enabled Users is the count of unique users assigned Microsoft 365 Copilot licenses over the selected period. The Adoption by app section reports enabled and active Copilot users for Microsoft 365 apps.

learnMore.text: Microsoft 365 Copilot Usage Report - Microsoft 365 admin

questions.questionText: You use Microsoft 365 Copilot. What does Copilot use to create responses from corporate data stored in Microsoft SharePoint?
questions.explanation: Microsoft 365 Copilot uses Microsoft Graph to retrieve and ground responses with organizational data, including SharePoint documents, while honoring each user's existing permissions.

learnMore.text: How does Microsoft 365 Copilot work?

questions.questionText: For each statement, select Yes when it is true. Otherwise, select No.

statements.text: Administrators can block specific websites from being used by Microsoft 365 Copilot.
Administrators can block Microsoft 365 Copilot from using web search when responding to user prompts.
Administrators can block access to the Researcher agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot, while allowing access to the Analyst agent.

questions.explanation: Microsoft 365 Copilot’s web-search policy is a global control; it does not provide granular blocking or allowing of particular websites. Administrators can disable web search so Copilot does not submit web queries to Bing. Administrators can also block the Researcher and Analyst agents, so access can be blocked for Researcher while Analyst remains available.

learnMore.text: Manage Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat

questions.questionText: Your organization has a Microsoft 365 subscription. All users have Microsoft 365 Copilot licenses assigned. Some users report getting Copilot responses that include information from a Microsoft SharePoint site named Finance. The users state that the information is commercially sensitive. You need to stop Copilot from providing responses that include information from the Finance site. What should you do?
options: A. From Microsoft Purview, create an Information Barrier (IB) policy.
B. From Microsoft Defender, create a data connector.
C. From Microsoft Entra, create a Conditional Access policy.
D. From the Finance site, configure permissions.
questions.explanation: Microsoft 365 Copilot accesses SharePoint data in the context of the signed-in user and honors that user’s existing permissions. Restricting permissions on the Finance site removes unauthorized users’ access to its content, so Copilot cannot use that content in responses for those users.

learnMore.text: How does Microsoft 365 Copilot work?
Understanding permission levels in SharePoint

questions.questionText: Your organization has a Microsoft 365 subscription. You need to use Microsoft Purview to meet these requirements: Prevent users from sharing files that contain Personally Identifiable Information (PII). Use machine learning to train a model that detects sensitive content. Which Microsoft Purview solution should you use for each requirement?

statements.text: Prevent users from sharing PII:
Use machine learning to train a model:

questions.explanation: Microsoft Purview DLP policies identify sensitive information and help prevent inappropriate sharing of sensitive files. Microsoft Purview Information Protection provides data classification, including trainable classifiers that learn from example content to identify sensitive content.

Microsoft Purview Information Protection

questions.questionText: For each statement, select Yes when it is true. Otherwise, select No.

statements.text: Microsoft 365 Copilot only surfaces the organizational data for which individual users have permissions.
Microsoft 365 Copilot uses the same underlying controls for data access as other Microsoft 365 services.
Microsoft 365 Copilot can use connectors to retrieve information from third-party data sources.

questions.explanation: Microsoft 365 Copilot is permission-trimmed: it accesses only data the signed-in user is authorized to access and honors existing Microsoft 365 access controls. Microsoft 365 Copilot connectors can bring content from external third-party sources into Microsoft 365 experiences, with access permissions applied to that content.

questions.questionText: Your organization has a Microsoft 365 subscription. The HR department requests a copy of all recent files modified by a user named User1. What should you use in the Microsoft Purview portal?
questions.explanation: Microsoft Purview eDiscovery can locate SharePoint and OneDrive files by properties including author and last-modified time, and it can export the matching content. Audit is used to review logged activities, not to retrieve copies of the files.

learnMore.text: Finding content in sites in eDiscovery
Export search results in eDiscovery

questions.questionText: Select the answer that correctly completes the sentence. The Microsoft responsible AI principle of [___] requires the oversight of AI systems to ensure that humans remain in control.
questions.explanation: Accountability requires people to oversee AI systems and remain responsible for their decisions and outcomes, ensuring that humans retain control.

questions.questionText: Select the answer that correctly completes the sentence. Microsoft 365 Copilot retrieves data from [___] by using Microsoft Graph.
questions.explanation: Microsoft 365 Copilot uses Microsoft Graph to access organizational content for grounding, including files stored in SharePoint.

learnMore.text: Microsoft 365 Copilot overview

questions.questionText: Select the answer that correctly completes the sentence. Restricted SharePoint Search enables you to restrict [___] access to Microsoft SharePoint sites without preventing users from accessing the files and content to which they have permission.
options: A. Restricted SharePoint Search - SharePoint in Microsoft 365
questions.explanation: Restricted SharePoint Search restricts Microsoft 365 Copilot’s access to a curated set of SharePoint sites. It does not alter existing user permissions, so users retain access to content for which they are authorized.

learnMore.text: Restricted SharePoint Search - SharePoint in Microsoft 365

questions.questionText: Select the answer that correctly completes the sentence. Microsoft Entra Privileged Identity Management (PIM) provides [___]
options: A. restricted access to Microsoft 365 services.
B. the lifecycle management of users.
C. the management of enterprise applications.
questions.explanation: Microsoft Entra Privileged Identity Management enables just-in-time privileged access: eligible users activate assigned roles when needed for a defined, time-limited duration.

questions.questionText: Your organization has a Microsoft 365 subscription. You discover that Microsoft SharePoint files are shared with users outside your organization. You need to identify which files are shared with those external users. Which report should you use in the SharePoint admin center?
questions.explanation: Use Data access governance. Its SharePoint reports help identify potentially overshared content and review sharing/access exposure.

learnMore.text: Data access governance reports for SharePoint and OneDrive sites

questions.questionText: Your organization has a Microsoft 365 subscription. Your company recently purchased Microsoft 365 Copilot licenses for some users. You need to identify how many unlicensed users have used Copilot in Microsoft Teams. Which usage report should you use in the Microsoft 365 admin center?
questions.explanation: The Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat usage report specifically covers users who do not hold a Microsoft 365 Copilot license, tracking their interactions with Copilot Chat across Teams, Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and other apps. The Microsoft 365 Copilot usage report, by contrast, reports only on users who already hold a Copilot license.

learnMore.text: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat usage report

questions.questionText: What can you use to block a user account automatically when a risky sigh-in is detected?
options: D. Microsoft Entra Privileged Identity Management (PIM)
questions.explanation: Microsoft Entra ID Protection detects risky sign-in behavior and automatically enforces risk policies, including blocking access or requiring password changes when suspicious activity is detected. This is the dedicated identity-risk tool within the Microsoft security stack. Defender for Identity focuses on on-premises threats; Defender for Office 365 protects email; PIM manages privileged access.

questions.questionText: Select the answer that correctly completes the sentence. In Microsoft Entra Privileged Identity Management (PIM), an administrator has made you eligible for the User Administrator role. Before you can create a user account, you must [___]
options: A. Activate Microsoft Entra roles in PIM
C. install the Microsoft Authenticator app.
questions.explanation: An eligible Microsoft Entra PIM role assignment provides no active permissions until the user activates it. Activating the eligible User Administrator role makes its directory permissions available, including the ability to create user accounts.

learnMore.text: Activate Microsoft Entra roles in PIM

questions.questionText: Your company is evaluating Microsoft 365 Copilot pay-as-you-go billing instead of purchasing a Microsoft 365 Copilot license. In which scenario can pay-as-you-go billing apply?
options: A. performing multi-step reasoning by using the Researcher agent
B. generating a recap of a Microsoft Teams meeting
C. using a custom agent that is grounded in work data
D. using the AI assistant to edit a document in Copilot in Word
questions.explanation: Pay-as-you-go billing for Microsoft 365 Copilot specifically applies to messages consumed by custom agents built in Copilot Studio that are grounded in organizational or work data. This consumption-based model allows organizations to pay per message rather than purchasing per-user licenses, making it suitable for scenarios with variable or broad audiences accessing custom agents. The other options represent core M365 Copilot licensed features requiring per-user licenses.

questions.questionText: For each statement below, select Yes

statements.text: Prompts and responses issued by users in Microsoft 365 Copilot are used by Microsoft to train models.
Content retrieved by using Microsoft Graph is used by Microsoft to train models.
Microsoft 365 Copilot honors the security permissions in your Microsoft 365 subscription.

questions.explanation: Microsoft 365 Copilot does not use prompts, responses, or data accessed through Microsoft Graph to train foundation LLMs. Its Graph grounding is scoped to the signed-in user’s existing Microsoft 365 permissions, so it does not access content the user is not authorized to access.

questions.questionText: Select the answer that correctly completes the sentence. [___] includes signals, such as collaboration history, document relevance, and communication frequency, which influence Microsoft 365 Copilot responses.
questions.explanation: Microsoft Graph connects Microsoft 365 data and relationship signals that Microsoft 365 Copilot uses to ground and personalize responses. Copilot Studio is for creating and extending copilots, Purview focuses on governance and compliance, and Viva Insights provides workplace analytics.

learnMore.text: Microsoft 365 Copilot overview

questions.questionText: You have a Microsoft SharePoint site named Site1 and a security group named Group1. You must prevent all users who currently have access to Site1 from accessing its content unless they are also members of Group1. Which settings should you configure?
questions.explanation: Set the site privacy to Private and configure Restricted site access with Group1. Restricted site access blocks users outside the specified Entra security group even if they previously had permissions or a shared link; a member must also have the underlying site or content permission.

learnMore.text: Restrict SharePoint site access with Microsoft 365 groups and Microsoft Entra security groups

questions.questionText: Your company uses Microsoft 365 Copilot pay-as-you-go billing. The company wants improved visibility into Copilot usage costs and the ability to forecast departmental spending. You need to ensure that you can view Copilot costs by department. What should you use?
questions.correctAnswer: The Microsoft 365 admin center, A billing policy

statements.text: Portal:
Feature:

questions.explanation: Microsoft 365 Copilot pay-as-you-go billing is configured in the Microsoft 365 admin center through billing policies. A billing policy allocates billing responsibility across departments, associates users with billing rules and an Azure subscription, and supports budget and spending monitoring. Auto-claim policies assign licenses, while Copilot connectors index external content; neither provides Copilot consumption billing.

Set up Microsoft 365 Copilot pay-as-you-go services

questions.questionText: Your organization has a Microsoft 365 subscription. You need to investigate security incidents and alerts generated by the Windows 11 devices in your organization. What should you use?
options: C. Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management
questions.explanation: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint provides endpoint detection and response capabilities for Windows devices, including investigating incidents and alerts, reviewing affected devices, and collecting related evidence.

Investigate devices in the Microsoft Defender for Endpoint Devices list

questions.questionText: Your company is piloting Microsoft 365 Copilot and has purchased 100 Microsoft 365 Copilot licenses. You need to view detailed reports on Copilot usage in Microsoft Teams, including meeting hours summarized by Copilot and meeting actions taken using Copilot. What should you use?
options: A. the Microsoft 365 Copilot readiness report in the Microsoft 365 admin center
B. the Microsoft 365 Copilot usage report in the Microsoft 365 admin center
C. the Microsoft 365 Copilot dashboard in Microsoft Viva Insights
D. the Microsoft 365 Apps usage report in the Microsoft 365 admin center
questions.explanation: The Microsoft Copilot Dashboard in Microsoft Viva Insights provides detailed adoption and impact metrics for Teams, including total meeting hours summarized or recapped by Copilot and meeting-summary actions taken using Copilot. Organizations with at least 50 assigned Copilot licenses have access to its full capabilities.

learnMore.text: Connect to the Microsoft Copilot Dashboard for Microsoft 365 customers

questions.questionText: User1 creates a Microsoft 365 Copilot agent named Agent1 and shares it with User2. What happens when an administrator blocks Agent1?
options: A. Agent1 is accessible to User1 and User2 until the users manually uninstall Agent. No other users can install Agent1.
B. Agent1 is accessible to User1 and User2, and no other users can install Agent1.
C. Agent1 is removed from User2, and User1 can continue to use Agent1.
D. Agent1is removed from User1 and User2, and no users can install Agent1.
questions.explanation: Blocking a Microsoft 365 Copilot agent blocks it for members of the organization: they cannot install or use it, and it is removed from users who had already installed it. This includes both the creator and users with whom it was shared.

learnMore.text: Understand agent details in Microsoft 365 admin center
Agent Registry in the Microsoft 365 admin center

questions.questionText: Your company has a Microsoft SharePoint site named Site1. Site1 contains all the policies of the company’s HR department. The policies are saved as Microsoft Word documents. All users have read access to Site1. The HR department manager reports that user requests about the policies are NOT being addressed in a timely manner, especially around major holidays. You need to recommend a solution to enable the users to find the HR department policies. The solution must provide the users with a list of common queries and ensure that responses are grounded only in Site1. What should you include in the recommendation?
options: A. the personal assistant in Copilot in Word
B. a custom Microsoft 365 Copilot agent
C. the Researcher agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot
questions.explanation: A custom Microsoft 365 Copilot agent can be scoped so its knowledge comes only from Site1, and it can be configured with a curated set of starter prompts covering the common HR policy questions users ask. The Researcher agent and the personal assistant in Copilot in Word are not restricted to a single SharePoint site, and a notebook is a personal workspace rather than a shared, discoverable tool for other users.

statements.text: A site member of a Microsoft SharePoint site can invite users to access the content in the site.
A site owner of a Microsoft SharePoint site can add Microsoft 365 groups as site members.
A site owner of a Microsoft SharePoint site can remove another site owner from the site.

questions.explanation: Site members have Edit permissions and can share site content unless sharing has been restricted by an administrator or site setting. Site owners have Full Control; they can add a Microsoft 365 group and can add or remove site owners.

questions.questionText: Your organization has a Microsoft 365 subscription. You need to assess your organization’s Identity Secure Score. Which two factors affect the score? Each correct answer presents a complete solution. > NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point. Choose two
options: B. the number of global administrators
C. passwords that are never expired
D. the location of the users
questions.explanation: Microsoft Entra Identity Secure Score includes recommendations to designate more than one Global Administrator and to not expire passwords. Compliance with these identity-security recommendations affects the score.

learnMore.text: What is the Identity Secure Score?

questions.questionText: Your organization has a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription. You need to prevent users from sharing corporate financial data to external users. What should you use?
questions.explanation: Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies detect sensitive information patterns (financial data, personally identifiable information) and automatically block or restrict sharing to external recipients. DLP rules can identify and prevent unauthorized external sharing of corporate financial data before transmission. Role groups, insider risk management, and retention labels do not provide content-based sharing controls.

questions.questionText: Your organization has a Microsoft 365 subscription. You need to assess the impact of a recent phishing incident that targeted email users. What should you use?
options: C. the Microsoft Entra admin center
D. the Microsoft Exchange admin center
questions.explanation: The Microsoft Defender portal provides Microsoft Defender for Office 365 investigation capabilities, including the Phish view in Threat Explorer or Real-time detections, to examine phishing email activity and its impact on affected users. It also consolidates incident alerts and evidence for investigation.

questions.questionText: Select the answer that correctly completes the sentence. John can [___] .
options: A. view all the users in the Microsoft Entra tenant
B. view all the content in Microsoft SharePoint sites
C. read all the content in Microsoft Exchange mailboxes
D. perform eDiscovery of Microsoft 365 Copilot prompts
questions.explanation: The Microsoft Entra Global Reader role gives read-only access to Microsoft Entra and Microsoft 365 administration data, so it can view users in the tenant. It does not authorize reading SharePoint site content or Exchange mailbox content, nor does it grant the eDiscovery permissions needed to search Microsoft 365 Copilot prompts.

questions.explanation: Microsoft Purview DSPM for AI monitors AI use and detects risky prompts and responses, including interactions involving sensitive information in Microsoft 365 Copilot.

questions.questionText: Your organization has a Microsoft 365 subscription containing Microsoft SharePoint sites and Microsoft Teams teams. You discover that sites and teams have been shared with users outside your organization. You need to determine which sites and teams were shared with the external users. What should you use?
options: B. the Microsoft Teams admin center
questions.explanation: The Microsoft 365 admin center centrally lists guest users and manages membership of active teams and Microsoft 365 groups. Microsoft Teams uses Microsoft 365 Groups for team membership, so external guest membership can be identified there for Teams and their group-connected resources.

Manage guest access in Microsoft 365 groups

questions.questionText: Your organization uses a Microsoft 365 subscription. All users are licensed for Microsoft 365 Copilot. You need to determine where sensitive content is used in Copilot interactions, analyze content-usage patterns, and receive recommendations for applying the appropriate protections. What should you use?
options: B. the Microsoft Purview DSPM for AI solution
D. the Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management solution
questions.explanation: Microsoft Purview Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) for AI assesses how Microsoft 365 Copilot interacts with sensitive data, provides visibility into AI usage and data exposure risks, and recommends controls such as sensitivity labels and data loss prevention policies to protect that data.

learnMore.text: Understand How to Secure AI Data with Microsoft Purview
Learn about Data Security Posture Management for AI

questions.questionText: Your organization has a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription. You create a Microsoft Purview sensitivity label named Label1. You need to ensure that users can apply Label1 to files in Microsoft 365. What should you use?
questions.explanation: A sensitivity label must be published via a sensitivity label policy to make it visible and applicable to end users. Creating the label alone does not expose it in Office applications; the policy controls which users see the label and what protection settings apply when it is applied. Trainable classifiers, retention policies, and auto-labeling policies serve different purposes in the information governance workflow.

questions.questionText: Select the answer that correctly completes the sentence. If a user shares a Microsoft 365 Copilot agent, you can use [___] to block users from using the agent.
options: A. Governance and Lifecycle actions for agents available in Microsoft 365 admin center
questions.explanation: The Microsoft 365 admin center provides lifecycle controls for Copilot agents, including blocking an agent so users in the organization cannot use it.

learnMore.text: Governance and Lifecycle actions for agents available in Microsoft 365 admin center

questions.questionText: You need to identify files and emails that contain social security numbers (SSNs) and credit card numbers. What should you use in the Microsoft Purview portal?
questions.explanation: Data Explorer in Microsoft Purview displays files and emails matching sensitive information type definitions, including built-in patterns for U.S. Social Security Numbers and credit card numbers. It shows where sensitive data is stored across SharePoint, OneDrive, Exchange, and Teams. Information Protection policies and Activity Explorer serve different functions; Information Protection reports lack the granular file/email visibility.
